hypothesis: Removing E27 Q/K INT8 quantization and compensating each PV probability as BF16 high plus BF16 residual will reduce H3 audio error while remaining materially faster than the exact wave32 BF16 production baseline; the portable exact kernel remains the paired numerical oracle only.

acceptance.stopping_rule: Stop before H3 integration unless GPU correctness, canaries, determinism, BF16 WMMA ISA, and the paired production operator threshold all pass. H3 model and media quality remain separate downstream gates.
